youtube.title: Why is an hour 60 minutes, not 100? 🕰️ #Shorts #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description:
Why is an hour 60 minutes and not a tidy 100? Because 60 is a sharing number. It splits into halves, thirds, quarters and more without ever leaving you with endless decimals. Try a third of 100 and you get 33.333 forever. The Sumerians, trading grain and sheep between two rivers 4,000 years ago, needed to divide things fairly, so they counted in sixties. Nobody knows for certain why, but it stuck for millennia. Full episode on the channel.
